model.name: Assign task as CURRENT or NEXT — owner-gated action units record explicit current/next (override derived, single-sourced in resolver; explicit-current unblocks the ambiguous pin)
model.description: TWO action units that SHIP TOGETHER (like R40.10 approve/decline): ASSIGN-AS-NEXT and ASSIGN-AS-CURRENT, on the universalActionBar (R40.5 action-unit dedup), ON the task item, OWNER-GATED (non-owner 403). Each RECORDS the assignment as DATA (assignedNextBy/At, assignedCurrentBy/At — R40.10 pattern) so the pin's current/next slots are PROVABLE not remembered. EXPLICIT overrides DERIVED, single-sourced INSIDE resolveSprintPin (current/next = explicit-if-set ELSE derived, never in a view). ★ The explicit assigned-CURRENT is the ESCAPE HATCH: it resolves the pin even when multiple sprints have open work (the resolver's current ambiguity that has parked T40.6 all session) — WITHOUT masking the ambiguity, which stays visible+counted via R-C5's audit (frozen-legacy pattern). 3-slot uniqueness (rotate/clear, no collision), @390 pixel, fail-loud. This is the SELECT mechanism for Tron's last/current/next. REUSE R40.10 + R40.5 + the existing resolver — do NOT fork.
model.tronQuote: a task needs to have the actions for the action bar: assign as next task [and] assign as current task

discoverySource.note: Completes the SELECT loop Tron corrected the PO on ('last, current unfinished, next — you easily can select them'). Both actions ship together. DESIGN-REQUIRED: (4) explicit-overrides-derived single-sourced in resolveSprintPin (no 2nd next/current source); (5) explicit-current unblocks the ambiguous pin (the session-long T40.6 blocker) WITHOUT masking ambiguity (R-C5 visible+counted); architect-flag: no auto status-transition. Ties R40.10 (owner-gated action + approvedBy/At) + R40.5 (action-unit) + R-C1 resolveSprintPin + R-C5 (audit).

model.crossRefNote: REUSE (do not fork): R40.10 owner-gated action machinery + approvedBy/approvedAt data pattern; R40.5 action-unit de-dup; R-C1 resolveSprintPin single-source (explicit-if-set ELSE derived); R-C5 audit for the visible+counted multi-Active ambiguity.

acceptanceCriteria.text: BOTH assign-as-NEXT and assign-as-CURRENT are ACTION UNITS on the universalActionBar (per R40.5 de-duplication — real action units, NOT bespoke buttons), living ON the task item (like R40.10's approve/decline). They SHIP TOGETHER (assign-next without assign-current leaves the main control missing).
BOTH owner-gated, non-owner => 403. Priority is Tron's call; nobody self-promotes their own work (same integrity as approve: if anyone can set current/next, they mean nothing).

RECORDS the assignment as DATA on the unit — assign-next => assignedNextBy/assignedNextAt; assign-current => assignedCurrentBy/assignedCurrentAt (the R40.10 approvedBy/approvedAt pattern) — so the pin's current AND next slots are PROVABLE not remembered (trustworthy after a rewind).

★ DESIGN-REQUIRED: EXPLICIT-assigned OVERRIDES DERIVED, single-sourced INSIDE resolveSprintPin — current = explicit-if-set ELSE derived; next = explicit-if-set ELSE derived; decided in the resolver, NEVER in a view. No two-sources-of-one-truth (the disease killed this session: two depref builders / two marker counts / two fabricated-uuid figures).

★ ESCAPE-HATCH (named AC): an explicit assigned-CURRENT resolves the pin EVEN WHEN multiple sprints have open work. resolveSprintPin currently THROWS on ambiguity (5 current-era Active: S19/20/21/25/37) -> R40.11's pin renders 'current: unresolved (pending A1 sign-off)' and T40.6 is coupled+parked. An explicit assigned-current ANSWERS the question the resolver cannot answer from data alone => the pin becomes RESOLVABLE IMMEDIATELY, WITHOUT first driving 40+ legacy tasks to terminal.

★ HONESTY CONDITION: the explicit-current must NOT silently MASK the ambiguity. The multi-Active condition stays VISIBLE and COUNTED — reported via R-C5's audit (the frozen-legacy pattern: EXCLUDED from the DECISION, NEVER hidden from the REPORT). An honest throw traded for a quiet lie is the exact disease we killed this session.

3-SLOT UNIQUENESS: only ONE current and ONE next. Assigning CURRENT to a task presently NEXT must rotate/clear the next slot; assigning either must not collide with lastCompleted. REUSE the pin's existing distinctness enforcement — do NOT reimplement.
@390 real-device PIXEL gate — both actions reachable AND fireable on his phone.
FAIL-LOUD: if the assignment cannot be recorded, show an EXPLICIT error — never a silently-unchanged pin.

★ ARCHITECT FLAG: does assigning CURRENT also TRANSITION the task (Planned -> In Progress) or leave status untouched? PO instinct = must NOT auto-transition (status stays checklist-derived per R-C5; assigning ATTENTION is not claiming WORK was started). His call — flagged, not decided.
